<!-- Generated by Ankus.DocGenerator. -->

Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Defines PostgreSQL configuration parameters whose names and metadata are computed at run time, as pgrx's
<code>GucRegistry</code> does.

```csharp
public static class PgGucRegistry
```

<p>
Call these methods from a [PgModuleLoadAttribute](/api/ankus.pgmoduleloadattribute/) method, as a pgrx extension calls <code>GucRegistry</code>
from <code>_PG_init</code>. PostgreSQL owns each definition for the life of the process: parsing, permissions, source
priority, <code>SET</code>, <code>RESET</code> and placeholder adoption behave as for attribute-declared settings.
</p>
<p>
Defining a parameter again with identical metadata returns another reader for it, so a retried module load is
harmless. A different definition with the same name, or a name declared by a [PgGucAttribute](/api/ankus.pggucattribute/), is
rejected. [Postmaster](/api/ankus.pgguccontext/#member-34f544a17b8dfb73) parameters can be defined only while
<code>shared_preload_libraries</code> is processed. Names follow PostgreSQL's custom setting rules, as the attributes require.
</p>
<p>
Prefer the [PgGucAttribute](/api/ankus.pggucattribute/) family for names known at compile time. Attributes add compile-time
validation, typed C# enum settings and managed check, assign and show hooks; run-time definitions have no hooks,
like pgrx's plain <code>define_*_guc</code> functions.
</p>
